description: Agent Labor Verification: submit billed labor hours with the contracted labor scope: the scope with its reference, the first and last day labor may be billed, the cap on total hours, each scoped task with the hours it allows, and each change order with its number, approval date, the tasks it adds or grows, the hours it adds and any new end date; the bill with its reference and each billed line with the day worked, the task, the hours and the change order it cites. The signed report gives the scope and the bill, each billed task against the scoped tasks and the tasks an approved change order adds, each scoped task’s billed hours against the hours the scope and its approved change orders allow, the running total against the hour cap, and each billed day against the end date and any approved extension, and counts them, and names divergent labor hours: hours billed outside the scope, scope growth billed with no change order, hours billed past the stated cap, and hours billed past the end date; then hours billed before the scope starts and a cited change order that is not approved, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No scoped tasks, no billed lines, no hours allowed per task, or no hour cap or end date leaves those points unverified. Tasks match by their reference or their words with plurals folded, a change order counts when it states its approval date, hours compare to the hundredth and dates by the day. This reads labor hours already billed against the labor scope contracted for them. Verdict labor_scope_divergent, labor_scope_partial, labor_scope_unverified or labor_scope_consistent. POST /api/labor-scope-check. Reads the labor records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never schedules or assigns work, never pays wages, never hires, disciplines or terminates anyone and gives no legal advice, which stay with the employer, the worker and their advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Labor Verification reads labor records for work already performed: a timesheet, a work-completion log, the licenses a worker held, an overtime claim, billed labor rates, billed labor hours, worker classification evidence and a wage record, each against the shift record, the agreed task list, the dates worked, the hours record, the rate card, the contracted labor scope, the classification claimed or the verified hours and agreed rates it answers to. The family checks hours, work, credentials and pay after the work is done; the Agent Hiring family checks decisions and documents before engagement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-labor-verification-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-labor-verification/.
